title: Breaking: Cloud Storage Watch Channel API Removed
summary: The Cloud Storage API has removed the `channels.stop` method and the entire `Channel` schema. This change discontinues the direct API support for managing push notification channels for object changes, representing a significant breaking change for applications relying on this functionality.
details: Developers using the `storage.v1` API for push notifications will find that the `resources.channels.methods.stop` method is no longer available. Furthermore, the `schemas.Channel` definition, including all its properties like `address`, `expiration`, `id`, `kind`, `params`, `payload`, `resourceId`, `resourceUri`, `token`, and `type`, has been entirely removed. This means any existing integrations that relied on the `Channel` schema or the `channels.stop` method for managing watch channels will break and require immediate remediation. Developers should explore alternative notification mechanisms, such as Cloud Pub/Sub notifications for Cloud Storage events.
